data.title: Areas near Bahrain US military base largely deserted months after Iran attacks | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: Despite negotiations between Washington and Tehran, Iranian attacks on Bahrain have not stopped, with the most recent attack targeting an undisclosed US military base in the country.
